canvas.$description: Used for the page background colour

default.$description: Default surface colour for cards, panels and standard content containers.

raised.$description: Surface colour reserved for elevated areas such as dialogs, popovers, floating panels or layered content.

default.$description: Default text colour for body copy and general content.

light.$description: Subtle border colour for low-emphasis separation, card edges and decorative dividers.

default.$description: Default border colour for visible separation between surfaces, sections or grouped content.

interactive.$description: Border colour for interactive elements such as inputs, selectable controls and default action states.
Default interactive foreground and border pairing for secondary or neutral actions.

foreground.$description: Default foreground colour for secondary or neutral interactive elements.

border.$description: Default border colour for secondary or neutral interactive elements.

primary.$description: Primary action colour pairing for the most important action in a section or flow.

foreground.$description: Foreground colour for content placed on the primary action background.

ring.$description: Focus indicator colour used to show keyboard focus and support accessible navigation.

featured.$description: Featured colour pairing for highlighted content, promotional areas or visually distinctive callouts.

background.$description: Background colour for featured content areas.

foreground.$description: Foreground colour for content placed on featured backgrounds.

success.$description: Status colour pairing for positive feedback, successful actions or confirmation messages.

foreground.$description: Foreground colour for content placed on success backgrounds.

warning.$description: Status colour pairing for cautionary feedback, warnings or important non-blocking messages.

foreground.$description: Foreground colour for content placed on warning backgrounds.

error.$description: Status colour pairing for errors, validation failures or destructive feedback.

foreground.$description: Foreground colour for content placed on error backgrounds.
